```yaml
name: Release

on:
  workflow_dispatch:
    inputs:
      version:
        description: 'Version to release (e.g., 1.4.0)'
        required: true
        default: '1.4.0'

jobs:
  release:
    runs-on: ubuntu-latest
    steps:
      - name: Checkout code
        uses: actions/checkout@v4
        with:
          token: ${{ secrets.GITHUB_TOKEN }}

      - name: Setup Python
        uses: actions/setup-python@v5
        with:
          python-version: '3.9'

      - name: Install dependencies
        run: |
          python -m pip install --upgrade pip
          pip install pylint
          pip install bump2version

      - name: Run tests
        run: |
          python -m pylint custom_components/dreo/

      - name: Get current version
        id: current_version
        run: |
          CURRENT_VERSION=$(jq -r '.version' custom_components/dreo/manifest.json)
          echo "current_version=$CURRENT_VERSION" >> $GITHUB_ENV

      - name: Bump version if needed
        if: env.current_version != github.event.inputs.version
        run: |
          bump2version --new-version "${{ github.event.inputs.version }}" patch --allow-dirty
          git config --local user.email "action@github.com"
          git config --local user.name "GitHub Action"
          git commit -am "Bump version to v${{ github.event.inputs.version }}"
          git tag -a "v${{ github.event.inputs.version }}" -m "Release v${{ github.event.inputs.version }}"

      - name: Push changes
        if: env.current_version != github.event.inputs.version
        run: |
          git push origin HEAD --tags

      - name: Create ZIP artifact
        uses: thedoctor0/zip-release@0.7.6
        with:
          filename: dreo-${{ github.event.inputs.version }}.zip
          path: custom_components/dreo

      - name: Create GitHub Release
        if: env.current_version != github.event.inputs.version
        uses: softprops/action-gh-release@v1
        with:
          tag_name: v${{ github.event.inputs.version }}
          name: Release v${{ github.event.inputs.version }}
          body: |
            ## Release Notes
            
            Automated release for version ${{ github.event.inputs.version }}
            
            ### Changes
            - Version bump to v${{ github.event.inputs.version }}
            
            ### Artifacts
            - dreo-${{ github.event.inputs.version }}.zip
          files: |
            dreo-${{ github.event.inputs.version }}.zip
```
